title: Confirmed Data Analyst - Demand
description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


Your mission
Our Data department is organised following Data Mesh principles, distributing data ownership to cross-functional and domain-specific teams that manage, own, and serve the data as a product.
The Data Demand team’s mission is to help BlaBlaCar grow as a global OTA through data, covering the full customer journey from brand and product discovery through marketing and landing pages, to search, booking, post-booking, and payment. As the team expands its scope from self-service towards decision intelligence, we want to strengthen our ability to proactively analyse member, marketplace, and product behaviours, and to influence the decisions that shape the product.
As a Data Analyst, you will join the Data Demand team to drive decision-making through data: framing the right questions with stakeholders, going deep into data to explain what is happening, sizing opportunities, interpreting experiments, and translating insights into actionable recommendations for Product and Marketing teams.
Your responsibilities
Partner with Product, Marketing, and Business stakeholders to understand their goals, frame analytical questions, and identify the decisions where data can have the highest impact.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and other Data Analysts to improve the quality, usability, and coverage of our data products, and explore opportunities to turn advanced analytics or ML/AI initiatives into measurable business impact.
Lead end-to-end analyses on product and business topics such as marketplace dynamics, search-to-book performance, member behaviour, audience knowledge, or CRM and marketing impact.
Go beyond dashboards to investigate the “why” behind trends, anomalies, and performance changes, combining exploratory analysis, statistical reasoning, and strong business context.
Build clear narratives from data: communicate findings, trade-offs, confidence levels, and recommendations in a way that helps stakeholders align and act.
Contribute to reusable business knowledge and context engineering by documenting insights, analytical frameworks, or business relationships, and play a governance role in aligning definitions, reducing gaps between teams, and improving data quality over time.
Leverage BlaBlaCar’s available GenAI tools to work more efficiently in day-to-day analysis and documentation, while applying strong critical thinking to challenge, validate, and contextualise the outputs before using them in decision-making.
Your qualifications
Master’s degree or equivalent: engineering school, business school, etc
At least 3 years of professional experience working as a Data Analyst
Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience analysing large and complex datasets.
Good understanding of product analytics, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation, experimentation, and performance monitoring.
Ability to structure ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions, and translate business or product questions into robust analytical approaches.
Experience with data visualisation, with a strong sense of how to design clear, trustworthy, and decision-oriented outputs.
Solid communication skills: you can turn analysis into a compelling story, adapt your message to different audiences, and influence decisions with clarity and humility.
Comfort working with cross-functional teams and building strong stakeholder relationships.
Curiosity for product, growth, marketplaces, and member behaviour, with a pragmatic mindset focused on impact over perfect analysis.
Python or another analytical programming language, causal inference, or advanced experimentation knowledge is a plus.
Fluent in English 
If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application!

4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
50% healthcare coverage (Alan)
Financial support for home office equipment
Minimum 25 days holiday per year 
Local meal plan policy (Swile card)
50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)
Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides
Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility programs
Employee Stock ownership plan
Regular team building events

description:
HI, WE’RE BACK MARKET.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

About the role

As part of the Bureau of Technology, you’ll design, build, and scale AI-driven solutions to improve our Customer Care. You’ll join a new team, Care AI (a mix of data scientists and software engineers) focused on enhancing the experience of our customers in need of help with faster and more precise resolutions. 
Your focus will be in implementing and scaling our Care AI agents and improving AI powered features aimed at increasing agents efficiency, detecting customer sentiment and speeding up resolutions.

What you will do

 - Identify company problems and opportunities that AI can address, own them end-to-end, from problem definition to production rollout, collaborating with stakeholders and relevant teams to design and ship the product features that solves them.

 - Hands-on development, productionisation, and operation of machine learning models and/or GenAI applications at scale. This includes integrating and optimizing LLMs for production environments.

 - Contribute to the development of the AI community within the company by promoting best practices and sharing your work internally to raise awareness about AI capabilities

 - Regularly present work internally (demo, internal conferences,...) to technical, engineering and product stakeholders to acculturate the business to AI related topics



About you

 - 6+ years of industry experience in data science or related fields, with a Master's or PhD in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Economics, Sciences, or Engineering)

 - Proven track record of leading impactful data science initiatives that solve real business problems, with the ability to mentor and develop scientists, engineers, and peers

 - Deep knowledge of the ML lifecycle, algorithms, best practices, and hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and Generative AI APIs

 - Strong ability to design end-to-end AI and data architectures that integrate with existing product systems, data platforms, and engineering infrastructure, with solid Python skills and software engineering fundamentals (testing, code review, deployment)

 - Proficiency in AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows (e.g. Claude Code), and strong communication skills to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences



Recruitment process:

 - Call with Stéphane, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner (1h)

 - Technical screening (30 min)

 - Technical Interview (1h15)

 - Stakeholder interview (1h)

 - Back Market Values fit interview - 45 min


WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.
